title: Three Seasons and One Short Brush
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：plot　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 plot 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the painter ① planned the plot that no visitor in the studio would have measured, and he said the planning was the whole of the season. The ② plot, meaning the story itself and not the brush, ran three seasons and stayed unmeasured in the book; a plot, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ plot in that studio had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ plot at the far easel, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A plot, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the painter said the measuring is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the plot was the whole of the matter, meaning the plan and not the story. The ⑥ plot, meaning the plan and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; plot, he said, is either something you plan or the only word that means both a story and a plan. He said the plan is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ plot had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ plot of the whole thing, the painter wrote in May, was one studio and three seasons of measuring; plot, he said, is either the sketch at the far easel or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ plot I remember is the story measured in the catalogue, which closed in 1972 and is still measured as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ plot, my mother said in 1974, is the only story that improves by being measured; every plot, she said, is a plan that has agreed to look like a story. She said the plan was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 情节；小块地（指画室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 情节；小块地（指那个情节本身，与小小的画笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：plan the plot 构思这一个情节
D. n. 情节；小块地（指留给孩子们留着的那一幅）
E. n. 情节之事（抽象总称，指一处画室的情节之事）
F. n. 情节；小块地（指展品目录里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 情节、筹谋（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 筹谋（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: planned the plot that no visitor in the studio would have measured
The plot, meaning the story itself and not the brush
the plot at the far easel
the plot was the whole of the matter
the plot had become a line in a catalogue
The plot of the whole thing
A plot, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: plan the plot 意为“构思这一个情节”，1965 年那位画师把画室里没有一位观者肯测量的一个情节做了一遍。
plot 意为“情节；小块地”，指那个情节本身而不是小小的画笔，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被测量。
plot 意为“情节；小块地”，指画室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。
plot 意为“情节；小块地”，指最远那副画架的留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
plot 意为“情节、筹谋”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个筹谋就是那件事的全部。
plot 意为“筹谋”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个情节，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
plot 意为“情节；小块地”，指展品目录里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1970 年这一个成了展品目录里的一行。
plot 意为“情节之事”，画师五月写道，整件事的情节之事是一处画室和三个季度的测量。
plot 意为“情节；小块地”，我记得的是展品目录里测量过的那一个，1972 年画成了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一个。
plot 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，情节是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的情节。
